Butter Chicken!!  Ingredients The chicken 2 lb chicken breast or thigh, cut into bite size pieces ⅓ cup greek yogurt  2 tsp kashmiri chile powder 2 tsp garam masala  1 ½ tsp turmeric  2 tsp garlic grated  2 tsp ginger grated 1 tsp fenugreek leaves 1 Tbsp olive oil The juice of 1 lemon 1 tsp salt The sauce 3 Tbsp ghee 4 cardamom pods 4 cloves 1 piece of cinnamon stick 4 cloves garlic, sliced 1 inch knob ginger, sliced 1 green chile, minced 24 oz crushed tomatoes ⅓ raw cashews  1 tsp kashmiri chile powder 2 tsp garam masala  1 cup cream 1 tsp fenugreek leaves Salt to taste To start in a bowl add the yogurt, kashmiri chile powder, garam masala, turmeric, garlic, ginger, fenugreek leaves, olive oil, lemon and salt. Mix well then add the chicken mix again, then add to a wire rack lined sheet tray, spread it into one layer. Broil for about 10 minutes until lightly charred. For the sauce in a large pan over medium high heat add the ghee then toast the spices for 2 minutes. Then remove them. Add the chili, garlic and ginger. Cook for 1-2 until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cashews, simmer for 10 minutes then blend until smooth. Add that back to the pan and add cream, kashmiri chili powder, garam masala, fenugreek and salt to taste. Add the chicken into the sauce and reheat it for 2-3 minutes. Serve with garlic naan and garnish with cilantro.  Enjoy!!

ive been on an old bay kick 🤤 recipe 👇🏻 For the Chicken Wings: * About 2 pounds chicken wings * 1 tablespoon baking powder * 1 teaspoon salt * 1/2 teaspoon black pepper * 1/2 teaspoon paprika * 2 tablespoons olive oil For the Old Bay Butter Sauce: * 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted * 2 tablespoons hot honey (adjust to taste for desired spice level) * 1 teaspoon Old Bay seasoning (adjust to taste) Instructions: 1. Prepare the Chicken Wings: a. Preheat your oven to 350°F. b. In a large bowl, combine the baking powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Mix well. c. Pat the chicken wings dry with paper towels to remove excess moisture. d. Toss the dry chicken wings in the spice mixture until they are evenly coated. e. Drizzle the vegetable oil over the wings and toss again to ensure they are coated evenly. 2. Bake the Chicken Wings: a. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper to prevent sticking. b. Place the coated chicken wings on the parchment-lined baking sheet in a single layer, making sure they are not overcrowded. c. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. 3. Crisping the Wings: a. After the initial 30 minutes, carefully flip the chicken wings using tongs. b. Increase the oven temperature to 425-450°F  c. Continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes or until the wings are golden brown and crispy. You may want to check them after 5 minutes to gauge how much longer they need. 4. Make the Hot Honey Butter Sauce: a. While the wings are in the oven, prepare the sauce by mixing warm melted butter, hot honey and old bay seasoning in a bowl. b. Taste and adjust the amount of hot honey and Old Bay to your liking for the desired level of heat and flavor. 5. Coat the Crispy Wings: a. When the wings are done baking and crispy, remove them from the oven and let them sit for 3 minutes so they stay crispy.  b. While the wings are still hot, transfer them to a large mixing bowl.  c. Pour the hot honey butter sauce over the wings and toss to coat them evenly. #gameday #gamedayfood #oldbay #oldbayseasoning #wings #chickenwings

Chicken Spaghetti is an easy 30 minute dinner my family loves!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, and garlic powder  1 tbsp olive oil  1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper  1 tsp each of onion powder, parsley, and paprika  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1 tbsp of minced garlic 10 oz can of Rotel (not drained) 2 cups of shredded cheese (I used Colby Jack) 1/4 cup of sour cream  1 lb of spaghetti  INGREDIENTS  Cook spaghetti following the directions on the box.  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken lightly with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder.  Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add some olive oil. Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until both sides are golden brown and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of at least 165 degrees F.  Once the chicken is cooked, remove it from the skillet. Shred the chicken or cut it up into cubes and set aside.  In the skillet, add 3 tbsp of butter. Add 3 tbsp of flour and stir. Let the flour and butter cook for at least minute. Next, pour 2 cups of chicken broth into the skillet. Add 1 tbsp of minced garlic, salt, pepper, onion powder, parsley, and paprika. Stir everything together well.  Once this mixture starts to thicken, add 1 can of rotel (not drained), about 2 cups of shredded Colby Jack cheese and 1/4 cup of sour cream. Stir.  Add the drained spaghetti noodles and the cut up chicken. Stir everything together well. Top with dried parsley.  Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out!  #easyrecipes #chicken #spaghetti #dinner #mealideas #familydinner

Chicken Alfredo is an easy and delicious dinner the whole family loves! INGREDIENTS  10 oz fettuccini 1 lb of chicken breast 1/2 tsp Salt and Pepper 1 tsp Garlic Powder and Italian Seasoning  2 tbsp butter  1 stick of butter  2 TBSP of minced garlic 1 1/4 cups of heavy cream 1/2 tsp salt 1/2 tsp pepper  1 tsp Italian seasoning  1 1/4 cup shredded Parmesan cheese Dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS  Boil fettuccini following the directions on the box.  Cut chicken in half lengthwise (to make them thinner) and season with 1/2 tsp salt and pepper, and 1 tsp garlic powder and Italian seasoning.  In a skillet over medium-high heat melt 2 TBSP of butter. Sear chicken on both sides until they are golden brown. Place in the oven at 400 degrees F to let the chicken finish cooking. I check with an internal meat thermometer to make sure it reaches 165 degrees F.  In a separate pan, melt 1 stick of butter over medium-low heat and add minced garlic stirring well. Add heavy cream, stirring constantly.  Add 1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper and 1 tsp of Italian seasoning. Add 1 1/4 cup of shredded Parmesan cheese stirring until it thickens.  Once the Alfredo is to the consistency you like add the cooked fettuccini and stir until well combined. Top with sliced chicken.  Serve and top with Parmesan cheese and some dried parsley. Enjoy! #dinner #recipe #easyrecipes #dinnerideas #alfredo #chickenalfredo #chickenalfredorecipe

Crispy Harissa Chicken Legs When I was doing some research a few weeks back I had my mind absolutely rocked by a recipe I tried from @FalasteeniFoodie Their page is incredible and I really encourage you to check it out. They made a yogurt-based blended marinade (which something I do all the time) but instead of fully blending the ingredients together until smooth, she left it really chunky so it almost looked like a dip or romesco. I gave it a shot and what I found to be really neat about the technique is that when you go to bake the chicken, you end up with all of these textured nooks and crannies that get super charred and caramelized. I wrote an article about it and developed a recipe inspired by her original post but I tweaked a few things—like adding adjusting the cook time/method and developing my own marinade—for what I think is an even tastier final dish. You can find my version at the link in my bio. Harissa Paste @elfassyfoods @erfedida #chickenrecipe #chicken #protein #kitchenhack
